properties.name: Alarm Rule Name
properties.description: Exact name of an existing cond.AlarmRule. The value is OData-escaped and must resolve to exactly one rule with its complete Devices array.

properties.name: Device Type
properties.description: Choose exactly Server, Chassis, Fabric Interconnect, Unified Edge or eCMC, or Registered Target.

properties.name: Device Organization
properties.description: Exact organization used to scope the selected device through PermissionResources.Moid.

properties.name: Device Name or Serial
properties.description: Exact server/chassis Name or Serial, or exact asset target Name for the selected device route.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style final status for validation, lookup, idempotent success, PATCH acceptance, or response verification.

properties.name: Result
properties.description: JSON-formatted final identity, merge summary, or failure detail.

properties.name: Status Message
properties.description: Human-readable final outcome distinguishing idempotent success from a verified update.

properties.name: Error Message
properties.description: Actionable failure guidance; empty on success.

Checks whether one organization-scoped device relationship is already present on an exact metrics alarm rule without removing assignments. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose default runtime user can read organizations, rules, inventory, and targets. Exact identity, ownership, cardinality, and every Devices entry are validated. An existing exact relationship returns idempotent success. If a new relationship would require replacing the complete Devices array, the workflow returns 422 before mutation because the current Generic Cisco Intersight API Request editor does not expose a supported conditional-header binding and an unguarded replacement could overwrite a concurrent edit. The 2026-07-27 Cisco SDK proves AlarmRules/Devices, but concrete mo.BaseMo mappings still require tenant validation. Use a supported purpose-built atomic when available.
properties.display_name: Cisco Intersight - Assign metrics alarm rule to device

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

validationStatus = "helper-failure"
validationStatusCode = "500"
validationMessage = "Input validation did not complete."
validationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":validationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
escapedRuleName = ""
escapedOrganizationName = ""
deviceCollection = ""
deviceFilter = ""
deviceSelect = ""
deviceRoute = ""

try:
    ruleRaw = sys.argv[1]
    deviceTypeRaw = sys.argv[2]
    organizationRaw = sys.argv[3]
    selectorRaw = sys.argv[4]
    ruleName = ruleRaw.strip()
    deviceType = deviceTypeRaw.strip()
    organizationName = organizationRaw.strip()
    selector = selectorRaw.strip()
    errors = []
    allowedTypes = ("Server", "Chassis", "Fabric Interconnect", "Unified Edge or eCMC", "Registered Target")

    if ruleRaw != ruleName or deviceTypeRaw != deviceType or organizationRaw != organizationName or selectorRaw != selector:
        errors.append("Inputs must not contain leading or trailing whitespace.")
    if not ruleName or len(ruleName) > 255 or any(ord(ch) < 32 or ch in "&?#%" for ch in ruleName):
        errors.append("Alarm Rule Name must contain 1-255 characters and no control or URL query-delimiter characters.")
    if deviceType not in allowedTypes:
        errors.append("Device Type must be exactly Server, Chassis, Fabric Interconnect, Unified Edge or eCMC, or Registered Target.")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}", organizationName):
        errors.append("Device Organization must match the organization Name schema: 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
    if not selector or len(selector) > 128 or any(ord(ch) < 32 or ch in "&?#%" for ch in selector):
        errors.append("Device Name or Serial must contain 1-128 characters and no control or URL query-delimiter characters.")

    escapedRuleName = ruleName.replace("'", "''")
    escapedOrganizationName = organizationName.replace("'", "''")
    escapedSelector = selector.replace("'", "''")
    if deviceType == "Server":
        deviceRoute = "server"
        deviceCollection = "/api/v1/compute/PhysicalSummaries"
        deviceFilter = "(Name eq '" + escapedSelector + "' or Serial eq '" + escapedSelector + "')"
        deviceSelect = "&$select=Moid,Name,Serial,ObjectType,ClassId,SourceObjectType,PermissionResources"
    elif deviceType == "Chassis":
        deviceRoute = "chassis"
        deviceCollection = "/api/v1/equipment/Chasses"
        deviceFilter = "(Name eq '" + escapedSelector + "' or Serial eq '" + escapedSelector + "')"
        deviceSelect = "&$select=Moid,Name,Serial,ObjectType,ClassId,PermissionResources"
    elif deviceType == "Fabric Interconnect":
        deviceRoute = "fabric-interconnect"
        deviceCollection = "/api/v1/asset/Targets"
        deviceFilter = "Name eq '" + escapedSelector + "' and (TargetType eq 'UCSFI' or TargetType eq 'UCSFIISM')"
        deviceSelect = "&$select=Moid,Name,ObjectType,ClassId,TargetType,PermissionResources,RegisteredDevice"
    elif deviceType == "Unified Edge or eCMC":
        deviceRoute = "unified-edge-ecmc"
        deviceCollection = "/api/v1/asset/Targets"
        deviceFilter = "Name eq '" + escapedSelector + "' and TargetType eq 'UCSXECMC'"
        deviceSelect = "&$select=Moid,Name,ObjectType,ClassId,TargetType,PermissionResources,RegisteredDevice"
    elif deviceType == "Registered Target":
        deviceRoute = "registered-target"
        deviceCollection = "/api/v1/asset/Targets"
        deviceFilter = "Name eq '" + escapedSelector + "'"
        deviceSelect = "&$select=Moid,Name,ObjectType,ClassId,TargetType,PermissionResources,RegisteredDevice"

    if errors:
        validationStatus = "invalid"
        validationStatusCode = "400"
        validationMessage = " ".join(errors)
        validationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Input validation failed","details":errors}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        validationStatus = "ready"
        validationStatusCode = "200"
        validationMessage = "Inputs, OData escaping, and the exact device route are valid."
        validationResultJson = json.dumps({"validated":True,"deviceType":deviceType,"deviceRoute":deviceRoute,"relationshipMappingRequiresTenantValidation":deviceType in ("Server","Fabric Interconnect","Unified Edge or eCMC","Registered Target")}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    validationStatus = "helper-failure"
    validationStatusCode = "500"
    validationMessage = str(exc)
    validationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Input validation helper failed","detail":validationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

import json
import re
import sys

organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
organizationStatusCode = "500"
organizationMessage = "Organization inspection did not complete."
organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
organizationMoid = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    values = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        raise ValueError("Organization response is missing a Results array.")
    if len(values) == 0:
        organizationStatus = "invalid"
        organizationStatusCode = "404"
        organizationMessage = "No organization matched Device Organization exactly."
    elif len(values) > 1:
        organizationStatus = "invalid"
        organizationStatusCode = "409"
        organizationMessage = "Multiple organizations matched Device Organization exactly."
    else:
        item = values[0]
        moid = item.get("Moid") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", moid):
            raise ValueError("Organization Moid is missing or not URL-safe.")
        if item.get("Name") != expectedName or item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization" or item.get("ClassId") not in (None,"organization.Organization"):
            organizationStatus = "invalid"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "Organization response identity or discriminator is inconsistent."
        else:
            organizationMoid = moid
            organizationStatus = "ready"
            organizationStatusCode = "200"
            organizationMessage = "Exactly one organization was validated."
    organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"status":organizationStatus,"message":organizationMessage,"organizationMoid":organizationMoid or None}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
    organizationStatusCode = "500"
    organizationMessage = str(exc)
    organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Organization inspection failed","detail":organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

import json
import re
import sys

ruleStatus = "helper-failure"
ruleStatusCode = "500"
ruleMessage = "Alarm-rule inspection did not complete."
ruleResultJson = json.dumps({"error":ruleMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
ruleMoid = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    values = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        raise ValueError("Alarm-rule response is missing a Results array.")
    if len(values) == 0:
        ruleStatus = "invalid"
        ruleStatusCode = "404"
        ruleMessage = "No metrics alarm rule matched Alarm Rule Name exactly."
    elif len(values) > 1:
        ruleStatus = "invalid"
        ruleStatusCode = "409"
        ruleMessage = "Multiple metrics alarm rules matched Alarm Rule Name exactly."
    else:
        item = values[0]
        moid = item.get("Moid") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        problems = []
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", moid):
            problems.append("Alarm-rule Moid is missing or not URL-safe.")
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("Name") != expectedName:
            problems.append("Alarm-rule Name does not exactly match the requested value.")
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("ObjectType") != "cond.AlarmRule" or item.get("ClassId") not in (None,"cond.AlarmRule"):
            problems.append("Alarm-rule discriminator is not cond.AlarmRule.")
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or "Devices" not in item or (item.get("Devices") is not None and not isinstance(item.get("Devices"), list)):
            problems.append("Alarm-rule response omitted the complete Devices array or returned an invalid value.")
        if problems:
            ruleStatus = "invalid"
            ruleStatusCode = "502"
            ruleMessage = " ".join(problems)
        else:
            ruleMoid = moid
            ruleStatus = "ready"
            ruleStatusCode = "200"
            ruleMessage = "Exactly one metrics alarm rule and its complete Devices array were validated."
    ruleResultJson = json.dumps({"status":ruleStatus,"message":ruleMessage,"ruleMoid":ruleMoid or None}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    ruleStatus = "helper-failure"
    ruleStatusCode = "500"
    ruleMessage = str(exc)
    ruleResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Alarm-rule inspection failed","detail":ruleMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

mergeStatus = "helper-failure"
mergeStatusCode = "500"
mergeMessage = "Devices merge did not complete."
mergeResultJson = json.dumps({"error":mergeMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
patchBody = ""
expectedDevicesJson = ""
successResultJson = ""

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", value) is not None

def normalize(items):
    if items is None:
        items = []
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        raise ValueError("Devices is not an array or null.")
    result = []
    pairs = set()
    by_moid = {}
    for index, value in enumerate(items):
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError("Devices entry " + str(index) + " is not a relationship object.")
        moid = value.get("Moid")
        objectType = value.get("ObjectType")
        classId = value.get("ClassId")
        if not safe_moid(moid) or not isinstance(objectType,str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*", objectType):
            raise ValueError("Devices entry " + str(index) + " has an invalid identity.")
        if classId not in (None,"mo.MoRef",objectType):
            raise ValueError("Devices entry " + str(index) + " has an unexpected ClassId.")
        pair = (moid,objectType)
        if pair in pairs:
            raise ValueError("Devices contains a duplicate relationship identity.")
        if moid in by_moid and by_moid[moid] != objectType:
            raise ValueError("One Devices Moid appears with multiple ObjectTypes.")
        pairs.add(pair)
        by_moid[moid] = objectType
        result.append({"ClassId":"mo.MoRef","ObjectType":objectType,"Moid":moid})
    return result

try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedRuleMoid = sys.argv[2]
    expectedRuleName = sys.argv[3]
    relation = json.loads(sys.argv[4])
    deviceType = sys.argv[5]
    values = envelope.get("Results") if isinstance(envelope, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(values,list) or len(values) != 1 or not isinstance(values[0],dict):
        raise ValueError("The alarm-rule response no longer contains exactly one object.")
    item = values[0]
    if item.get("Moid") != expectedRuleMoid or item.get("Name") != expectedRuleName or item.get("ObjectType") != "cond.AlarmRule" or item.get("ClassId") not in (None,"cond.AlarmRule"):
        raise ValueError("Alarm-rule identity changed between lookup and merge.")
    if "Devices" not in item:
        raise ValueError("The alarm-rule response omitted Devices.")
    current = normalize(item.get("Devices"))
    new = normalize([relation])[0]
    if any(value["Moid"] == new["Moid"] and value["ObjectType"] != new["ObjectType"] for value in current):
        raise ValueError("The new device Moid already exists with a different ObjectType.")
    exact = [value for value in current if value["Moid"] == new["Moid"] and value["ObjectType"] == new["ObjectType"]]
    merged = list(current)
    if exact:
        mergeStatus = "already"
        mergeStatusCode = "200"
        mergeMessage = "The exact device relationship is already assigned; no PATCH is required."
    else:
        merged.append(new)
        mergeStatus = "ready"
        mergeStatusCode = "200"
        mergeMessage = "The complete Devices array is ready with the new relationship appended."
        patchBody = json.dumps({"Devices":merged}, separators=(",", ":"))
    expectedDevicesJson = json.dumps([{"Moid":value["Moid"],"ObjectType":value["ObjectType"]} for value in merged], separators=(",", ":"))
    mergeResultJson = json.dumps({"status":mergeStatus,"ruleMoid":expectedRuleMoid,"deviceType":deviceType,"priorDeviceCount":len(current),"resultingDeviceCount":len(merged),"fullArrayReplacementBlocked":mergeStatus == "ready","mutationAttempted":False}, separators=(",", ":"))
    successResultJson = json.dumps({"updated":False,"idempotent":True,"ruleMoid":expectedRuleMoid,"ruleName":expectedRuleName,"deviceRelationship":new,"deviceCount":len(merged)}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    mergeStatus = "invalid"
    mergeStatusCode = "502"
    mergeMessage = "Devices merge validation failed: " + str(exc)
    mergeResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Devices merge validation failed","detail":mergeMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
